meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 装上后,当你要发布新版本时,Claude 会全程负责:确认版本号、触发自动构建、检查发布结果、写发布说明,并把公告发到 Discord。它只做发布,不会擅自审查或修改代码。
howto.when: 当你说出 'publish'、'release'、'deploy' 等关键词,或要求 npm 发布,并指定版本类型(patch/minor/major)时触发;没指定的话它会先向你确认。

say.note: Claude 会启动自动发布流程
触发工作流并生成发布说明
执行完整发布并在 Discord 公告

howto.what_en: When you ask to publish a new release, Claude runs the full workflow: confirms the version bump, triggers the GitHub Actions build, verifies the release, writes the release summary, and posts the announcement to Discord. It only ships — it never reviews code unless you explicitly ask.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'publish', 'release', 'deploy', or ask for an npm publish, and specify a bump type (patch/minor/major). If no bump type is given, Claude will ask for it first.

say_en.note: Claude will run the full publish flow
Triggers the workflow and writes release notes
Runs the complete workflow and announces on Discord
